sentences.text: Heino Marine Brokerage Oy is a company registered on 2026-08-18 under the industry code 47631, retail sale of boats and boating accessories.
First sales are recorded on 2026-08-17, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-08-21.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the registered industry is boat retail, which is trade rather than technology, and no other record is on file.
